entry.title: New: Resolution 611 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO NEGOTIATE A SIXTY-FIVE YEAR LEASE WITH THE HOUSING AND LAND ENTERPRISE OF HAWAIʻI COUNTY, DBA: HALE O HAWAIʻI FOR THE PURPOSE OF DEVELOPMENT AND CONSTRUCTION OF A BELOW MARKET RATE SINGLE-FAMILY HOME ON TAX MAP KEY: 2-4-051:094 FOR A COMMUNITY LAND TRUST PROGRAM AT A SET LEASE AMOUNT OF $10.00 PER YEAR

Allows for Hale O Hawaiʻi to finance, construct, and sell a below market rate home on state lands, subject to affordability restrictions, to an eligible purchaser for affordable housing and shelter purposes.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 611-24 & LAAC-68 - 10/2/2024
